$comment: Claude Code plugins bundled with app-agent. Installed only by the Claude adapter's --plugins / -Plugins switch, which runs `claude plugin marketplace add <marketplace>` then `claude plugin install <plugin>`. Upstream commits are the versions reviewed when they were added; the install itself takes the marketplace's current version.

plugins.name: spartan-ai-toolkit
plugins.purpose: Engineering workflow packs: /spartan:* commands, rules, skills and agents (spec, plan, build, pr-ready, product and frontend packs).
plugins.notes: Overlaps the superpowers and mattpocock-skills workflows. app-agent routing keeps those as primary; use /spartan:* commands when asked for by name. Ships a session-start update check that runs git fetch on its own install.

plugins.name: planetscale
plugins.purpose: PlanetScale hosted MCP server (organizations, databases, branches, schema, Insights) plus MySQL, Postgres, Vitess and PlanetScale safety-review skills.
plugins.notes: The MCP server signs in to your PlanetScale account on first use. Its database skills (postgres, mysql) are useful without a PlanetScale account.
